g.text: One fixed lipid parent; paired evaluation seeds; every delivered row retained.
The Agent introduced the age cap of 100 as an assumption, not a literature-derived or target-validated boundary.
All non-age columns match exactly across these versions; changing age alone leaves lipid coherence unchanged.
This secondary tail redesign does not constitute improvement on the prespecified primary endpoint.
